title: program_version
description: A versioned instance of a Kansas water-infrastructure grant program. Each statutory or policy change that alters eligibility criteria, scoring categories, or administration creates a new ProgramVersion rather than overwriting prior history. HB 2462 (2026) is an example of a change that requires a new version.

version_id.description: Stable governed identity for this program version.

program_name.description: Official program name as stated by the source.

statutory_basis.description: Statutory or policy basis reference, e.g. 'KSA § ... (2026 HB 2462)'. Required when a legislative act drives the version change.

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year this version governs, e.g. FY2027.

effective_date.description: Date on which this program version became effective.

supersedes_ref.description: Reference to the prior ProgramVersion this version supersedes, or null for first versions.

document_title.description: Title of the authoritative program document for this version.

document_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the governing document, if available.
